title: Create Wet Cardboard
description: Adds Soggy & Wet Cardboard Swords to Create
body:
Create Wet Cardboard adds two new cardboard tube variants to the Create Mod.

The soggy cardboard tube is crafted by mixing a cardboard tube with water.  
This tube has lower knockback than the regular cardboard tube.

The wet cardboard tube is crafted by mixing a soggy cardboard tube with water.  
This tube has lower knockback than the soggy cardboard tube.

By enchanting all types of cardboard tubes with knockback at different levels, it's possible to create an entire range of golf clubs so that you can use Create Mod packages as golf balls.

This mod will not be maintained, updated or ported.  
It was created purely for the Just Create SMP Modpack.
